title: Task run creation returns Task model requiring latest_run.id for run actions
answers: Why does /runs/{taskId}/stream/ return 404 after triggering a task run?
Where is the run ID in the PostHog tasks run endpoint response?
How to get the task run ID from the tasks run API response?
body:
The task run creation endpoint in products/tasks/backend/presentation/views/api.py responds with the parent Task object rather than the TaskRun.
Any run-scoped operation (such as streaming task execution logs or dispatching commands) must read `latest_run.id` instead of the top-level `id`.
Enforced in products/tasks/backend/presentation/views/api.py on the `run` action.
If skipped, clients pass the task ID to run-specific endpoints (e.g. `/runs/{taskId}/stream/`), resulting in silent, permanent 404 errors.
applies: Tasks API run creation and run-scoped endpoints
says: Streaming task execution logs returns page not found right after triggering a run
Cannot view live console output after launching a new cloud agent run
